notes: Internal corpora score transcripts (cpWER family; RTTM is boundary-approximate because references carry segment-start timestamps only). External benchmarks have true fine-grained RTTM ground truth plus audio, so backends run end-to-end there. session_id = sanitized episode stem (internal) or corpus uri (external).

deutsch.ref_note: _qafixed is QA-format (not speaker turns) so diarization eval prefers _vrb; _cemanual is the fallback for episodes that only have CE-manual refs
deutsch.audio_note: mp3 per stem, fetched from transcript-metadata YouTube links and duration-verified against Deepgram JSON (fetch_corpus_audio.py); S3 archival via s3_archive after user confirmation

fda.note: FDA C19 townhall transcripts live only under exchanges/qrag_fda-c19-townhalls (S3-manifested); promote into data/ and vet references before eval use

voxconverse.note: RTTMs in clone (dev/ and test/); audio fetch script to be added when needed
